Plot:
King Agnarr tells young Elsa and Anna a story about their grandfather, King Runeard, who made a pact with the Northuldra tribe by building a dam in the Enchanted Forest. A fight breaks out, angering the elemental spirits of Earth, Fire, Water, and Wind, which seal the forest in mist. Years after the events of Frozen, Elsa hears a mysterious voice calling to her. Accompanying her sister Anna, Kristoff, Olaf, and Sven, Elsa embarks on a journey beyond Arendelle to discover the origin of her magical ice powers, uncover the truth about her kingdom's past, and save her home from a looming disaster. Frozen II is an epic fantasy adventure about self-discovery, sisterhood, growth, and righting past wrongs.

To ensure an authentic representation of the Indigenous culture depicted through the Northuldra people, Disney signed a historic contract with representatives of the Sámi people of Northern Europe.
